scope: Independent read-only source and mathematical review; own exact model tests and native-export binding. No new native build, commit, push, or probability attestation.

resolved_material_findings.finding: Prior filtering SQLite VIEW could hide a retained fork when only schema_version stability was checked.
resolved_material_findings.resolution: Native census compares the entire sqlite_schema map to source-defined cold-open DDL inside the same read snapshot before enumeration and before output. Actual integration negative control renames blocks and creates a filtering view; it expects OWNER_CENSUS_SCHEMA.

resolved_material_findings.finding: Python bool equality could impersonate included/observed integer heights in exported confirmations.
resolved_material_findings.resolution: Native score bridge now applies strict uint checks; reader tests include the negative control.

resolved_material_findings.finding: A packet directory symlink could undermine a literal artifact-root assertion.
resolved_material_findings.resolution: Bridge refuses packet-directory and packet-file symlinks and checks the resolved parent.

native_source_conclusions: Complete claim is only all currently present admitted rows of the supported local snapshot, not historical deletion coverage.
Budget/cancellation/profile refusal never yields a partial successful census.
Full supported W1/application replay, native target/work, parent-height, state/delta, timestamp ancestry and local maximum are rechecked.
Read transaction rolls back; output is fenced against epoch/state/generation changes. Epoch is not an audit of every external transaction.
Strict activation of one supplied candidate can leave an already retained eligible heavier candidate unselected; actual exported selection deficits are 2 and 6.
No global first-ready, remote/preprocessed inventory, process authenticity, authenticated physical clock or probabilistic qualification follows.

finite_help_review.conditional_theorem: P(E) <= min(1,D*B) from fixed complete transcript alphabet and uniform forced-transcript fresh-strategy bounds.
finite_help_review.proof_review: Expansion over classical receiver histories gives actual branch response weights at most the forced response branch weight. Sum over one prior global support; no conditioning of fresh oracle law on T=t.
necessary_premises_explicit: All oracle-dependent external influence is through charged queries or the complete classical interface.
No uncounted joint initial oracle correlation, quantum side input or shared quantum steering.
Transcript alphabet is fixed across all oracles and executions, including payload lengths, source, order, visible timing, absence, errors and visible signature/proof encodings.
Every forced-transcript strategy obeys hard Q/M caps on all counterfactual paths.
finite_help_review.cryptographic_scope: ML-DSA verification plus external exact endpoint/key pins authenticates signed statements and complete declared fragments. Full W1/MU1 replay verifies retained artifact predicates. Neither authenticates whole-world mediation or recorder execution.

composition_review.global_interval_packing: One global unique-ready ledger and fixed probability threshold; no window independence or free query/initial-state reset.
composition_review.risk_bank: Computed conditional failure probabilities from a complete declared finite joint law; pathwise allowance spending is a sufficient interface, while a separately justified expectation budget would also suffice.
composition_review.finite_advice: Explicit truth-table advice gives the sharp binomial success tail and an independently enumerated joint recording-tail profile.
composition_review.same_view_limit: Actual stable local view projection is identical, but attempts and process clock intervals differ. Full-observation indistinguishability requires separate same-public-schedule noninterference coupling.
